name: Shinpu
source:
Main character of "Story 3 - Crimson hair"

A former priest. [spoiler]Due to his smuggling of contagious animals, a disastrous epidemic has spread throughout the village, killing everyone. [url=/c88249]You[/url], along with [url=/c92092]Kanna[/url], encountered him when gathered clues led them to a church outside of the village.[/spoiler]
